name: bb10-volte
scope: Rooted SQN100-3, SQC100-2 and SQW100-4 on OS 10.3.3.3216; Mobile 460-00, Unicom 460-01 and Telecom 460-11 USIM without ISIM. Nine historical voice/SIM/display cases; r14 SMS, short bidirectional voice and normal reboot accepted on Q20/Unicom and Passport/Mobile. First Root accepted on Apple Silicon Mac/Q20 and Windows/Passport; full GUI first-use, Q10 first Root and Intel USB flashing unverified. r15 adds early exact-variant checks, 13 gated manual candidate combinations, six read-only Passport combinations, first-use tutorial and local feedback; no new hardware acceptance. r16 adds native mobile management and shared protocol 2; version-specific mobile hardware acceptance is recorded separately. r17 / mobile v10 includes a Passport/Mobile data-centric mitigation after a real call drop; three calls of at least two minutes, two-way audio, continuous LTE and bidirectional short/long/repeated-content SMS passed on SQW100-4/Mobile. Startup requires the system Root success notification. Remaining acceptance and final artifact receipts are recorded separately; no new hardware admission. Mobile v11 fixes late-response language switching and completes Chinese state, phase and error text; wireless payload remains r17. r18 / mobile v12 repairs runtime-directory traversal after verified fresh preparation or update under the mobile private umask. Passport/Mobile v12/r18 fresh installation, full restore/uninstall/reinstall, IMS, three two-minute calls and bidirectional short/long/identical SMS passed. The owner accepted the prior isolated Passport wake reset without a software-fix claim. Q20/Unicom migrated its exact allowlisted old payload through the native UI to r18. After one restored startup timeout, the next normal boot passed IMS, three two-minute calls, bidirectional audio/LTE, short/long/identical SMS and persisted call acceptance; the prior timeout cause remains unproven. Q20 full reinstall, Q10 and native SIM-change acceptance are tracked separately. r19 / mobile v13 adds blocking progress, confirmation-result recovery and one-time graphical app provisioning. It embeds the unchanged r18 phone-service manifest and files; UI changes do not require replacement of an already verified r18 service. These changes require their own artifact and hardware acceptance and are not included in immutable r18/v12 artifacts. Android-to-root APK bootstrap was retired after a separate Q20 kernel loader reset. Mobile v14 adds a read-only, strictly qualified one-restart suggestion for restored Passport/Unicom policy transitions, with durable per-installation/SIM budgeting. Mobile v15 shows explicitly labelled cached observations on ordinary opens and requires an explicit status check; the Root request deadline increases from 30 to 150 seconds while independent lower-level limits remain unchanged. Job identities and current call context are independently checked before settling operations. It retains the same r18 engine; source and host-test validation do not establish phone latency or new hardware acceptance. Mobile v16 refines bilingual states, distinguishes app and management-component update identities from the detected phone-service state, extends the 150-second idle deadline only on real verification progress with a 15-minute hard limit, and conservatively preserves unknown device-write tasks. Version-specific artifact and hardware acceptance remain separately recorded. Mobile v17 reduces repeated verified snapshot reads within one request. Mobile v18 verifies the selected private snapshot fully while avoiding rereads of unused copies on the warm path; initial creation still verifies the full source. Exact artifacts, phone timings and hardware acceptance remain separately recorded.
